title: Shell base environment survives inherit_env=false
severity: high when used as an isolation boundary; otherwise medium
behavior: ShellExecOptions documents false as using only per-call env, but OsEnv clears process env, conditionally copies process env, then unconditionally applies self.shell_env before per-call env. Base variables therefore survive false unless explicitly overwritten.
technical_explanation: The inherit_env branch ends at line 857; the shell_env loop at 858–862 is outside it. This can carry credentials or execution configuration across a caller-requested clean environment.
parity_relation: Overlaps AGENT-049 and violates Rust's own documented ShellExecOptions contract.
assumptions: Requires nonempty shell_env. No claim that every current caller treats inherit_env=false as a security boundary.
provenance: Problematic logic is present at upstream 0fb2d893206981527b14e86d68e3ddbdf2c8189a, crates/rpi-tools/src/os_env.rs:850-867. One non-upstream blame line in the surrounding slice is only the mechanical rpi→ice comment; behavior predates rebrand.

title: Unpolled stdout/stderr can block child completion
behavior: stdout_task and stderr_task are local async futures, not spawned tasks. The code pins them but awaits only status_fut until the child is reaped, then starts join! on the pipe readers under a grace timeout.
technical_explanation: Pinning does not poll a future. A child that fills either OS pipe blocks on write while the parent waits for exit; without a deadline/cancellation that can wait indefinitely. With a timeout it can be killed even though it would complete if output were drained. Streaming callbacks also do not run during the pending normal child wait.
parity_relation: Overlaps AGENT-050 shell execution/streaming parity and is an independent correctness defect in process I/O.
assumptions: Requires enough output to fill a pipe while the process is running. OS pipe capacity is platform-dependent; no fixed threshold is claimed. Timeout/cancellation depends on supplied options.
provenance: Unpolled ordering is present in upstream v0.6.1, crates/rpi-tools/src/os_env.rs:1035-1057; blame db4eacd64e8c24939345fb6bd4efc2ef4328ee13 is an ancestor of 0fb2d89.

title: Prompt-template scanners corrupt non-ASCII UTF-8
behavior: Placeholder scanners iterate raw UTF-8 bytes and push each ordinary byte as a Unicode char. Multibyte text is re-encoded as separate characters, altering instructions even when no placeholder occurs.
technical_explanation: replace_dollar_n line 415 uses out.push(bytes[i] as char) and advances one byte. The later slice-placeholder scanner has the same pattern, so text may be corrupted again. This is not valid UTF-8 scalar iteration or copying an untouched byte span.
parity_relation: Overlaps AGENT-057 literal-text preservation and changes user instructions independently of optional compatibility metasequences.
assumptions: Requires non-ASCII text passing through a scanner, including affected inserted values before a later scanner. No runtime demonstration was executed.
provenance: Same byte cast exists at upstream v0.6.1 crates/rpi-harness/src/prompt_templates.rs:393-419; blame df8cba823d887338c197fb5f9fb830961032797c is an upstream ancestor.

title: Concurrent final SpanGuard drops can lose completion callback
behavior: Two guard-clone drops can both observe strong_count==2 and choose the early return before either releases its local Arc; both releases then destroy shared state without invoking on_end.
technical_explanation: The reference-count observation and release are separate operations. SpanEnd has no Drop finalizer; its FnOnce callback is only invoked by successful try_unwrap. The finish Mutex does not serialize the refcount check/release.
parity_relation: Separate Rust defect in a capability to preserve, not evidence of a TypeScript-style observation dashboard.
assumptions: Requires concurrent cloned-guard drops on separate threads without outside serialization. Sequential last-drop use ordinarily works.
provenance: Present in upstream v0.6.1 crates/rpi-telemetry/src/context.rs:83-103; blame 91d89082dd6d09d3cdbbb0d55ceb6ab88e1a9523 is an ancestor. Independent reviewer /root/audit_session confirmed the source interleaving.
